summary: Implemented the SHACL path parser and tests as two new files; nothing committed. Added rdflib/extras/shacl.py with SHACLPathError(Exception) and parse_shacl_path(shapes_graph, path_identifier), following the spec's step order (Literal raises TypeError; IRIs return unchanged except rdf:nil; RDF lists, sh:inversePath, sh:alternativePath, and the three modifiers; everything else, including None and plain strings, raises SHACLPathError). Added test/test_extras/test_extras_shacl.py with a module-scoped Turtle fixture, one parametrized test covering valid and invalid shapes (with a graph-unchanged check), and a separate test for None and plain-string inputs. Verified: test_extras_shacl.py and test/test_path.py pass (39 tests) under the prepared venv. Not verified: mypy and black are not installed in that venv, so type-check and formatting are unconfirmed; some bare-IRI operator expressions may need or lack type-ignores. Next step: run mypy and black in an environment that has them.
